newsitem.title: USA: Onsite Energy signs Ontario Hydro deal.
newsitem.headline: Onsite Energy signs Ontario Hydro deal.

text.p: Onsite Energy Corp, based in San Diego, Calif., announced Monday an agreement with Ontario Hydro to provide energy services to industrial customers in the Canadian province.

Onsite said it will provide services such as consulting, engineering, installation, management and operation of energy efficiency projects for customers eligible for an energy efficiency program sponsored by Ontario Hydro.
The Canadian utility has identified two potential pilot projects at a large pulp and paper manufacturer and a large automotive manufacturing facility, Onsite said.
